meta_description: Bansals is a trusted emergency plumber in Derby. Fast response times, honest pricing, and expert repairs. Call now for same-day service.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or broken boiler in Derby? We arrive within the hour, any time of day or night.
services_subhead: From emergency burst pipes to routine boiler maintenance, we handle all plumbing jobs with speed and precision.

services.title: Emergency Burst Pipes
services.desc: Discover a burst pipe at 2am? We're there fast. We locate the leak, stop the water, and repair or replace the damaged section — minimising water damage to your home.

services.title: Boiler Repair & Installation
services.desc: Boiler broken down? We diagnose faults quickly and carry common parts on the van. We also fit new boilers and arrange power flushing to keep your system running efficiently.

services.title: Radiator & Heating
services.desc: Cold radiators, leaking valves, or noisy pipes? We balance systems, replace faulty thermostatic valves, and repair or install new radiators to restore warmth to every room.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: Fitting new taps, replacing bath panels, installing showers, or moving pipes for a kitchen refit — we handle all domestic plumbing with minimal disruption to your home.

services.title: Drain Unblocking
services.desc: Slow drains or complete blockages? We use professional drain rods and high-pressure jetting to clear debris, hair, and tree roots without damaging your pipes.

services.title: Leak Detection & Repair
services.desc: Hidden leaks costing you money? We track down water leaks behind walls and under floors, then repair them properly to prevent future damage and damp.

about_pullquote: I started this business to give Derby honest plumbing at a fair price.
about_para_1: Bansals has been serving Derby and the surrounding area for over 15 years. We've built our reputation on turning up on time, diagnosing problems correctly, and charging a fair price — no hidden extras or cowboy tactics. Every job, whether it's a midnight emergency or a planned installation, gets the same care and attention.
about_para_2: Our customers trust us because we answer the phone, we listen to what's wrong, and we fix it properly the first time. We're based right here in Derby, we know the area well, and we're genuinely proud of the repeat business and word-of-mouth referrals we've earned over the years.
reviews_heading: What Derby Homeowners Say About Bansals

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe at 11pm on a Sunday. Called Bansals and they were here by midnight. Fixed it properly, left the place clean, and the bill was reasonable. Couldn't ask for better service.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Replaced our boiler and fitted new radiators in the bedrooms. The lads were professional, polite, and finished on time. They even explained how to bleed the radiators properly. Will definitely call them again.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Came out to look at a dodgy tap that was leaking all night. Found the problem, sorted it in 20 minutes, and didn't overcharge. Honest and reliable — that's what I'd tell anyone looking for a plumber in Derby.
reviews.author: Simon H.
